verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a broad first-party REST API (v1 and v2, with OpenAPI 3 specs). It covers granular UI actions such as converting leads and deals, merging persons, adding followers, and managing webhooks, plus a Node client and an official MCP server for acting on deals and pipelines. missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement, API coverage evidence for campaigns, projects and workflow automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no features are UI-only.
